title: Prescriptions Training Note: Units Replaced after a Wrong-Strength Fill
content:
When a Kestrel Prescriptions fill is confirmed as the wrong strength, the replaced strength units are the units of that wrong-strength fill which the strength-error remake replaces. They depend on how long after pickup the patient reported the error and how long the pharmacist's review took.

## The rule

The wrong-strength pickup date is the event date of the pickup entry that names the wrong-strength fill, and every span is counted in calendar days from its first date as day 0. The prescribed daily units are the prescription's written quantity divided by its written days supply.

1. When the report was made **3 or more days** after the wrong-strength pickup date, the replaced strength units are the prescribed daily units multiplied by the wrong-strength fill's days supply dispensed less the days from the wrong-strength pickup date to the report date, never below zero.
2. When the report was made **fewer than 3 days** after that pickup date and the pharmacist's review came **3 or more days** after the report date, the replaced strength units are the prescribed daily units multiplied by the wrong-strength fill's days supply dispensed less the days from the wrong-strength pickup date to the review date, never below zero.
3. Otherwise the replaced strength units are the quantity dispensed on the wrong-strength fill.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical fill: written 60 units for 30 days, so 2 daily units; wrong-strength fill of 60 units and 30 days supply, picked up on day 0)

| Report date | Review date | Days pickup to report | Days report to review | Tier | Replaced strength units |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| day 3 | day 4 | 3 | 1 | 1 | 2 multiplied by 27, which is 54 |
| day 5 | day 6 | 5 | 1 | 1 | 2 multiplied by 25, which is 50 |
| day 2 | day 5 | 2 | 3 | 2 | 2 multiplied by 25, which is 50 |
| day 1 | day 4 | 1 | 3 | 2 | 2 multiplied by 26, which is 52 |
| day 2 | day 4 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 60 |
| day 0 | day 0 | 0 | 0 | 3 | 60 |
| day 40 | day 41 | 40 | 1 | 1 | never below zero, so 0 |

## Questions answered

**The report came on day 2 after pickup and the review on day 4.** The report is fewer than 3 days after pickup, but the review is only 2 days after the report, so the replaced strength units are the full quantity dispensed on the wrong-strength fill.

**Which days supply is used?** The days supply dispensed on the wrong-strength fill; the daily units come from the prescription's written quantity and written days supply.
